svg.title: Datapath block diagram of top_filter
svg.desc: Data flows from pix_in through window_3x3, conv3x3 stage 1 and stage 2, then the output stage that rounds or takes the Sobel magnitude, selects by mode and registers pix_out. Bus widths are labeled.
svg.text: rows: newest on top (w2x to w0x)
Solid = data bus. Dashed = control, see the control diagram. s = signed.
